title: Bug: [Chassis] MultiAsics support is needed for test_dip_sip testcases in ipfwd suite
author: mannytaheri
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

The newly added testcases in ipfwd suite (ipfwd/test_dip_sip.py::test_ipv4_forwarding) fail in MultiAsics chassis.  MultiAsics support is required.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/17058

```
Failure:
E           tests.common.errors.RunAnsibleModuleFail: run module command failed, Ansible Results =>
E           failed = True
E           changed = True
E           rc = 2
E           cmd = ['ip', 'route', 'add', '201.1.1.1/32', 'via', '10.0.0.41']
E           start = 2025-07-13 23:56:07.654342
E           end = 2025-07-13 23:56:07.660664
E           delta = 0:00:00.006322
E           msg = non-zero return code
E           invocation = {'module_args': {'_raw_params': 'ip route add 201.1.1.1/32 via 10.0.0.41', '_uses_shell': False, 'warn': False, 'stdin_add_newline': True, 'strip_empty_ends': True, 'argv': None, 'chdir': None, 'executable': None, 'creates': None, 'removes': None, 'stdin': None}}
E           _ansible_no_log = None
E           stdout =
E           stderr =
E           Error: Nexthop has invalid gateway.
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Run ipfwd suites for the newly added testcases:
ipfwd/test_dip_sip.py::test_ipv4_forwarding

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual:E           tests.common.errors.RunAnsibleModuleFail: run module command failed, Ansible Results =>

E           end = 2025-07-13 23:56:07.660664
E           delta = 0:00:00.006322
E           msg = non-zero return code
E           invocation = {'module_args': {'_raw_params': 'ip route add 201.1.1.1/32 via 10.0.0.41', '_uses_shell': False, 'warn': False, 'stdin_add_newline': True, 'strip_empty_ends': True, 'argv': None, 'chdir': None, 'executable': None, 'creates': None, 'removes': None, 'stdin': None}}
E           _ansible_no_log = None

No errors when MultiAsics support is added.
